notes: 55-inch Android-based interactive signage touch display (IPS panel, IR 10-point touch). Port list combines BenQ's own official specification page (archived 2022 snapshot, most complete/current revision) with an earlier official snapshot (2020) of the same page that explicitly itemized RS232 In/Out and IR Loop Through, which the later table omitted from its condensed layout but which remain documented in BenQ's IL550 accessory list (RS232 cable/RS232 loop cable, IR extender/loop cable included in box) and third-party retailer listings (SWS Distribution, B&H). DVI is listed by BenQ only as "DVI Input/Output x1/x1" without specifying I vs D; industry listings and the presence of a paired "3.5mm audio in (VGA)" jack indicate the DVI port is the combo DVI-I type (accepts VGA via adapter), so DVI-I was chosen with a note. HDMI input count differed across firmware/spec revisions (1x in the 2020 snapshot vs 2x HDMI 1.4 in the 2022 snapshot, no HDMI out in either); the more recent 2×HDMI 1.4 figure was used. USB-A includes one data (2.0) port and one power-only port (no data, so given as an unnamed accessory-power port rather than a full I/O entry — omitted from the port list since it carries no signal). DisplayPort and DVI outputs are loop-through daisy-chain ports for multi-display setups, not independent display outputs. LAN is 10/100 Mbps only (eth-100m grade). No dedicated power connector type is stated beyond "AC 100-240V, 50/60Hz" with a region-specific IEC-style cord; modeled as IEC (C13/C14) which is standard for this class of BenQ signage, though the exact inlet type (IEC vs captive cord) was not explicitly pictured in the sources reviewed.
